title: On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons---a statistical look at the METR plot
abstract: arXiv:2610.12466v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: METR's 50\% time horizon measures the human completion time of software tasks that an AI solves with 50\% probability, allowing AI capabilities to be expressed in interpretable units. On 228 tasks and 26 AIs, we recompute the time horizons using splines and item-response theory to relax the assumption that the AI difficulty of a task depends linearly on the log of human time. Our fitted spline can be interpreted as a function that \emph{converts} human time to AI difficulty; it is nearly flat in a region from 2--30 min but close to linear elsewhere. Hence, a time-horizon jump from 3 min to 30 min is much easier than one from 30 min to 5 hours despite the same multiplier of $10 \times$. Overall, we contribute time-horizon point estimates that perform better under a cross-validated suite of proper scoring rules, as well as diagnostic plots for assessing time horizons' construct validity. translated_title: 关于AI时间视野估计与有效性的研究——从统计学视角审视METR图表
translated_abstract: METR的50%时间视野衡量的是AI以50%概率成功解决的软件任务所需的人类完成时间，从而能以可解释的单位表达AI能力。本文基于228个任务和26个AI，使用样条函数和项目反应理论重新计算时间视野，放宽了“任务对AI的难度与人类时间的对数呈线性关系”这一假设。我们拟合出的样条可被解释为将人类时间转换为AI难度的函数；它在2至30分钟的区间内近乎平坦，但在其他区域接近线性。因此，尽管倍数同为10倍，时间视野从3分钟跃升至30分钟远比从30分钟跃升至5小时容易。总体而言，我们贡献了在一组经交叉验证的适当评分规则下表现更优的时间视野点估计，以及用于评估时间视野构建效度的诊断图。我们建议时间视野应结合……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 本文用样条函数和项目反应理论重新估计了METR的AI时间视野，发现人类时间与AI难度的关系并非全局线性（在2至30分钟区间近乎平坦），因此同样10倍的提升，从3分钟到30分钟远比从30分钟到5小时容易实现。
en_tdlr: Using splines and item-response theory to re-estimate METR's AI time horizons, this paper shows the human-time-to-AI-difficulty mapping is nearly flat in the 2–30 min region, so a 10× jump from 3 min to 30 min is much easier than from 30 min to 5 hours.
